name: Onmy Tag
summary: Onmy Tag  a virtual reality horror game that drops players into a dark, abandoned warehouse filled with mystery, danger, and primal fear. Designed for VR platforms and utilizing gorilla-style locomotion made popular by games like Gorilla Tag, Onmy Tagoffers a unique blend of physical movement and psychological terror that pushes the limits of immersive horror gaming.
